description: XTRA POWER SDS Max Drill Bits, Pack of 2, Multiple Sizes 6x110/10x160/12x160/10x310/12x310/14x310/16x310 mm (6 X 110 mm Pack of 2) - Distributed/Packaged by Generic. Product Details: The XTRA POWER SDS Max Drill Bits are precision-engineered tools designed for heavy-duty drilling applications in concrete, masonry, and stone. Available in a convenient pack of 2, these drill bits come in a wide range of sizes — 6x110 mm, 10x160 mm, 12x160 mm, 10x310 mm, 12x310 mm, 14x310 mm, and 16x310 mm — making them suitable for a variety of drilling depths and diameters. The SDS Max shank ensures a secure, tool-free bit change and delivers maximum power transfer from the hammer drill to the bit, resulting in faster and more efficient drilling. Built with a robust carbide tip, these bits are designed to withstand the rigours of demanding job sites and prolonged use. Whether you are a professional contractor or a serious DIY enthusiast, these drill bits offer reliable performance and durability. Compatible with all SDS Max rotary hammer drills, they are an essential addition to your power tool accessory kit. Please refer to the size specifications carefully before selecting the appropriate bit for your project.
